tasks.short: Locate and record comparable property sales

steps.what: Define property class, valuation date and useful comparable sale characteristics.
Locate sales using specialized property software in {OTHER} and existing personal records.
Examine candidate sales for condition, provenance, transaction terms and actual comparability.
Record selected comparable sales fields in the appraisal worksheet from the licensed export.
Record comparability caveats and reconcile imported sales against original source details.
Save the working comparable worksheet in its existing location.

tasks.design: Configure saved searches in the licensed property-sales category of {OTHER}, then use its native export to populate the existing {SPREADSHEET} comparable table. The appraiser selects the comparables, records qualifications and reconciles every imported field; incomplete exports stay manual.
tasks.previous_blocker: Search settings and manually copied transaction details are separate from the appraisal worksheet.
tasks.enabler_now: Saved filters and native tabular import may already exist; no valuation model is needed.
tasks.still_hard: A sale price does not establish comparability, authenticity or equivalent sale terms.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise a misleading comparable and explain its limits.

ambition.what: Test a second defensible comparable set for unusual equipment appraisals.

tasks.altitude: Less repeated search setup and copying; valuation authority stays unchanged.

reach.task: Document reasons for excluding a candidate comparable

evidence.claim: Native saved searches and structured imports can remove repeated filter entry and literal field copying, not comparability judgement.

assumptions: Boundary is locating and recording comparable sales, not inspecting the subject or determining value. Shares are provisional design estimates, not measured baselines.

Licensed source providers produce sale id, date, description, price, currency, units, premium/tax basis and source link in their normal sale-publication process. Appraiser search and selection are counted in s1-s3; s5 retains missing-field capture, import repair and source checks. No free new structured feed is assumed.

Test native source filters and worksheet import first. The 35% cut on s2 removes seven hours of repeated filter setup and navigation per 100 task hours; source discovery and reading remain. S4 removes actual re-key only where a compatible licensed export exists. Existing automatic imports earn no saving.
Ordinary worksheet saving needs no added approval. No new report or send is introduced.
unknowns: Actual repeated filter setup and copying time
research_questions: Can the native export preserve premium basis and source references without manual remapping?

already_counted.description: Search, comparability, caveats and reconciliation including failed import repair

incremental.description: Maintain source field mapping and saved search defaults

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R73 gives 27 gross less 2 upkeep =25 net. Low5 keeps all20 re-key hours when export fields are incompatible but still removes7 repeated filter hours less2 upkeep. No adoption means no saving and no new upkeep.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Write and submit property appraisal reports

steps.what: Select actual appraisal workpapers, valuation conclusion and report requirements.
Populate the report with exact property identifiers, valuation tables and referenced photographs.
Write the appraisal report narrative from the selected workpapers and findings.

loop.input: Fixed report source package and report shell
loop.output: Draft narrative with workpaper references and explicit gaps
loop.check: Appraiser checks every description, qualification and cited finding, then supplies the valuation rationale in s4 and reviews the complete report in s5
loop.stop: One draft and one correction; unsupported statements, missing provenance or contradiction return to manual writing within retained time
loop.why_not_simpler: Native fields handle s2; varied descriptive prose cannot be reduced to literal field substitution.

steps.what: Write valuation reasoning, limitations and conclusions for the particular property.
Check the complete final report, certification and intended recipient before release.
Save the checked report in the existing appraisal file.
Submit the exact approved appraisal report to the intended client.

tasks.design: Test native report fields and attachment insertion in {DOCS} first. A bounded model drafts descriptive prose from the actual workpapers; the appraiser retains valuation reasoning, full factual review and release of the exact final report through {EMAIL}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Literal assembly and case-specific writing are mixed in report preparation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native document fields can assemble facts; bounded drafting can reorganise supplied descriptions without deciding value.
tasks.still_hard: Defensible value conclusions, provenance uncertainty and material limitations need the appraiser.
tasks.human_edge: Stand behind the reasoning and explain why the evidence warrants this value.

ambition.what: Offer a plain-language companion explanation of an equipment valuation, separately reviewed before release.

tasks.altitude: Report preparation shifts toward reasoning and verification; professional decision rights do not change.

reach.task: Explain the evidence behind a property valuation

evidence.claim: Field assembly and source-bound narrative drafting can assist a report while leaving valuation reasoning and release review with its author.

assumptions: Boundary starts with genuine completed appraisal workpapers; no saving is assigned to producing their evidence or deciding the value. This report assembly differs from recording comparable sales or maintaining the completed-appraisal index.

Workpapers produced during the actual appraisal contain assignment id, property description, effective date, concluded values, units, basis, limitations and photograph references. S1 selects and checks them; s3-s5 retain missing-field entry, failed assembly repair and semantic checks. Unstructured files use manual insertion, not a free extraction feed.

S2 applies only to actual manual repetition of workpaper fields, not an existing automatic report generator. S3 removes9 hours of initial prose composition while21 remain for writing and checking case-specific descriptions; all20 valuation-reasoning hours remain.
S5 approves an external release, not an ordinary internal save. Approval binds final file content and recipient; any amendment repeats s5 before s7. S6 has no gate and no saving.
unknowns: Native template coverage and actual report content mix
Whether confidential workpapers may enter a bounded drafting service
research_questions: Does the draft preserve every valuation qualification without adding an unsupported factual claim?

already_counted.description: Source selection, narrative correction, valuation reasoning, final release review and delivery

incremental.description: Maintain report field mappings and sample source-bound drafting failures

approvals.approved_version: Exact final report content and recipient checked in s5; any change invalidates release approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R71 gives29 gross less2 upkeep=27 net. Low18 retains all30 narrative hours for unusual antiques or disputed provenance, while compatible native report fields still remove20 assembly hours less2 upkeep. Illustrative, not measured.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Create and maintain a completed appraisal database

steps.what: Create database fields and decide indexing, access and retention for completed appraisals.
Enter exact completed report metadata into the appraisal records database in {OTHER}.
Reconcile index entries to completed reports, resolving duplicate identities, dates and missing metadata.
Maintain database corrections, report links and controlled historical supersession references.
Save ordinary index edits in the existing database.

tasks.design: Configure the native appraisal records database category in {OTHER} to import exact completion metadata from existing {DOCS} report fields. The appraiser maintains indexing choices and checks duplicates, broken links and missing metadata; no value is recalculated and no report is released.
tasks.previous_blocker: Completed report metadata is copied into a separate searchable index.
tasks.enabler_now: Native field mapping can avoid that actual double entry where report metadata is available.
tasks.still_hard: Historical reports may lack consistent identifiers or record which valuation version superseded another.
tasks.human_edge: Distinguish a repeat appraisal from a duplicate and preserve the historical meaning.

ambition.what: Provide an internal inventory of equipment appraisals due for reconsideration, with dates checked by an appraiser.

tasks.altitude: Less metadata copying; more attention to which historical entries are genuinely comparable. No change to valuation rights.

reach.learn: Retention, access controls and historical version relationships

evidence.claim: Native metadata imports can remove literal re-entry while identity resolution and missing historical fields remain human work.

assumptions: Boundary is the database of already completed appraisals, not valuation, report drafting or report submission. Structure maintenance in s1 is the task's actual create/maintain work, not a fabricated per-case schema-design requirement; shares reflect a provisional pooled workload.

Report authors produce assignment id, property id/class, completion date, effective valuation date, value/currency, report version and file link in the normal completed report. S1-s2 locate actual files; s3-s4 retain missing metadata capture, mapping failures and identity repairs. No new administrative source record is assumed.

Test native import before any custom integration. S2 earns saving only where these fields are currently re-keyed into a separate index. For paper or incompatible historic documents use manual entry; existing automatic indexing earns none.
This is a private searchable index, not a client release or an authoritative new valuation. Ordinary entries and saves need no self-approval stage.
unknowns: Historical metadata consistency and workload frequency
research_questions: Can the native importer preserve original and superseding report links without silently overwriting history?

already_counted.description: Index structure, source reconciliation, duplicate and missing-field repairs and saved corrections

incremental.description: Maintain completion-field mapping and inspect failed batches

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R65 gives35 gross less3 upkeep=32 net for compatible metadata currently copied. Low0 retains all manual metadata entry for historical documents without usable fields and does not deploy the import or incur its upkeep. Neither case credits existing database runtime.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Arrange safe access, lighting and useful views of the property.
Take photographs showing property identity, condition and relevant defects using camera equipment in {OTHER}.
Check photographs for focus, colour, coverage and accurate depiction; retake inadequate views.
Transfer original photographs to the existing assignment folder in {DOCS}.
Check destination and intact files, saving the ordinary assignment folder contents.

tasks.design: Keep access, camera work and image adequacy with the appraiser. Where files are manually moved today, configure the camera/photo-management category of {OTHER} to transfer intact originals to the selected {DOCS} assignment folder, retaining the ordinary destination check without an approval gate.
tasks.previous_blocker: Camera files and assignment folders can require a separate manual transfer.
tasks.enabler_now: Native folder import or synchronisation may remove file copying without altering photographic evidence.
tasks.still_hard: Reflections, small defects, colour fidelity and safe access require actual camera work.
tasks.human_edge: Choose views that show what matters rather than merely producing attractive images.
tasks.altitude: Photographic judgement and decision rights stay unchanged; only an actual file-transfer chore changes.

evidence.claim: Native original-file transfer can avoid manual copying but cannot photograph an unobserved defect.

assumptions: Boundary includes actually taking and storing photographic evidence, not generating synthetic views, report caption writing or client delivery. The existing assignment folder is selected during s1 setup; no new tagging register is introduced.

The appraiser produces actual original image files in s2, checks them in s3, and supplies the correct assignment destination during setup. Native transfer uses file id, original timestamp, checksum and folder id; s5 keeps the ordinary destination check. Failed transfer is repeated manually, with added failure allowance in upkeep; no original is deleted automatically.

S4 is eligible only where actual manual file selection/copying takes9 of these provisional task hours. Test native transfer first; its runtime is not human work. Existing automatic camera-to-folder storage has no copying baseline and earns no saving.
No additional approval is required for an author storing these original photographs internally. S5 keeps its small existing time, fully retained.
unknowns: Whether image transfer is already automatic
Actual manual copy burden and device permissions
research_questions: Can native transfer preserve intact originals and unambiguously target the current assignment?

already_counted.description: Access, image capture, retakes, quality and destination checks

incremental.description: Reconnect device permissions and manually recover occasional failed transfers

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R91 gives9 gross less1 upkeep=8 net for actual manual copying replaced. Low0 retains the entire copy step for isolated cameras or already automatic storage and avoids adding sync upkeep. Physical capture and image judgement retain90 hours in either case.

role.altitude: Use less time copying sales, report fields and completed-appraisal metadata; concentrate on comparability, valuation reasoning and the integrity of evidence.
reach: Maintain a reliable internal appraisal index with records-management training
role.ambitious_version: An appraiser with a more traceable evidence base and clearer explanations, retaining personal judgement over value and report release.
